component.name: ClipShelf
component.summary: Clipboard history for Linux, like Win+V on Windows
היסטוריית העתקות ללינוקס, כמו Win+V ב־Windows

description.p: ClipShelf remembers what you copy — text and images — and brings it back with Super+V. Click an item and it is pasted into the window you were working in, just like the clipboard history on Windows.

ul.li: Text and images, with a search box
Pin the items you use often
Opens as a small panel next to the system tray
Skips passwords copied from password managers
Works with right-to-left languages; the interface is available in 13 languages

description.p: First release as a .deb package. The app now sets up its keyboard shortcuts and start-at-login by itself.
